question: Which of the following Articles of the Indian Constitution provides that no child below 14 years of age shall be employed to work?
solution:
The correct answer is __Article 24__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• Article 24 prohibits the employment of children below the age of 14 years in any factory, mine or other hazardous activities like construction work or railway.
 
• It is an absolute prohibition. Hence statement 1 is correct.
